versions.changelog:
Initial release of hr-archsystem — a comprehensive HR organization structure and job level system design tool.

- Covers organization design, job level system, competency dictionary, and job evaluation modules.
- Provides AI-era considerations and integrates industry-standard frameworks (e.g., McKinsey 7S, Korn Ferry Hay).
- Includes clear modular navigation and workflow for end-to-end HR system setup.
- Outlines key design principles and practical triggers for module application.
